payload.text: The pre-commit gate lives in .githooks/, read through core.hooksPath (0064). It refuses a staged .md or .rs that is not formatted and never rewrites it: prettier --write <file> or bin/devbin fmt rust, git add, commit again. A store body (an issue, a WP body) must be prettier-stable before intent set or intent issues add, or its view drifts and the doctor gate refuses every later commit.
